seo.title: Select & Save - Save Web Text, Code & Screenshots with On-Device AI
seo.description: Select text from any webpage or document and instantly save it as QnA knowledge cards with automatic screenshot capture, deep-link navigation, and 100% private local Chrome AI.

hero.badge: 🚀 Powered by Chrome Built-in Local AI (Gemini Nano)
hero.headline: Highlight Anything. Save Everything. Query Privately with Local AI.
hero.subheadline: Select any text, code snippet, or article section across the web. Save it with visual screenshot capture, organize into auto-domain folders, and query your knowledge base offline using built-in browser AI.

features.title: One-Click Quick Action Bar
features.description: Simply highlight text on any webpage. A floating overlay appears allowing you to instantly Save to QnA, Search Google, or ask Claude/ChatGPT in a single tap.

features.title: Automatic Visual Snippet Capture
features.description: Every saved note automatically captures a high-resolution, cropped screenshot of the selected text area alongside rich HTML formatting.

features.title: On-Device Gemini Nano AI Chat
features.description: Query your entire saved library using Chrome Built-in AI. Zero cloud server requests, zero API key fees, and complete offline privacy.

features.title: Deep-Link Text Fragment Highlighting
features.description: Click 'Open Original Webpage' on any snippet to jump directly to the original site. Select & Save automatically scrolls and re-highlights the exact section for you.

features.title: Smart Domain & Custom Folders
features.description: Organize snippets effortlessly with automatic domain-based folders, custom color-coded collections, tag filtering, and @folder query scoping.

features.title: Dynamic Visual Mosaic Layout
features.description: Switch seamlessly between a sleek Masonry Mosaic Grid and a clean List View to browse text snippets, code, and visual clippings effortlessly.

howItWorks.title: How Select & Save Supercharges Your Research in 3 Steps

steps.title: Highlight & Click
steps.description: Select any text or code on any webpage. The unobtrusive action menu lets you save it instantly to your personal QnA vault.

steps.title: Auto-Capture & Categorize
steps.description: Select & Save automatically extracts structured HTML, crops a visual screenshot, attaches the source URL, and routes it to domain folders.

steps.title: Ask Local AI & Re-Visit
steps.description: Search your library using plain English with built-in Gemini Nano AI or click back to jump straight to the source context on the original web page.

comparison.title: Why Choose Select & Save over Traditional Web Clippers?

faq.question: Is Select & Save completely free?
faq.answer: Yes! Select & Save is 100% free to use with no hidden subscriptions, cloud limits, or mandatory registration.

faq.question: How does the local Chrome Built-in AI work?
faq.answer: Select & Save utilizes Chrome's native Prompt API powered by Gemini Nano. All AI processing happens locally inside your browser GPU/NPU. Your data never leaves your computer.

faq.question: What happens if Chrome AI flags aren't enabled on my browser?
faq.answer: No problem! Select & Save features a smart indexed search fallback that instantly filters and streams your matching snippets based on titles, domain tags, and text content.

faq.question: Can I export or backup my saved library?
faq.answer: All your data is stored securely in chrome.storage.local. You maintain full ownership over your knowledge base.
